title: Balancing of the ambient coefficient specialization
statement: For a ringed geometric pullback with invertible structural coefficients and a compatible algebra square, fix normalized scalar derived presentations, an ordinary restriction comparison with its generator equation, a scalar-association derived isomorphism normalized by kappa, a coefficient isomorphism with its generator equation and an ambient tensor isomorphism normalized on two resolving factors. Then the localized restriction comparison followed by underlying scalar association equals the ambient coefficient specialization at every derived object.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 06YU; scalar-unit refinement with sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; parent proof steps 1–6.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative P and a second flat-term K-flat resolution Q of the coefficient module. Cancel the invertible resolution maps in both scalar tensor normalization equations. The ambient normalization on (P,Q) identifies its coefficient specialization with ordinary cochain tensor comparison.

The restriction and extension normalizations identify the other composite with restriction followed by balanced cochain scalar association. On generalized pure tensors both routes send a tensor (p tensor b) to (a tensor p) tensor b; one intermediate expression is (one tensor p) tensor (a-bar times b), equal by the tensor balancing relation. The generator equations fix the scalars and actual diagram transitions.
The sheafified tensor universal property and direct-sum totalization give equality of chain maps. Full faithfulness on resolving objects gives equality on all unbounded derived objects.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formalization of the parent scalar/unit refinement of Tags 07A4 and 0G7E.
